name: r03b_pocket_stays_where_it_was
why: THE ABSOLUTE TWIN of `r03_centered_pocket` (entry E18): the same pocket, without `anchor`. It proves that the old way keeps working when it is what is wanted — a pocket that sits at x = 0 because there is something there that corresponds to it, not because it is the centre.
intent_why: without an anchor x_mm/y_mm are coordinates of the model: bringing the length to 260 the plate goes from X -100 to +160 and the pocket stays at x = 0. The centroid goes to x = 30.588 instead of 30: it is the difference that `r03` measures, seen from the other side.

after.tolerance_why: plate 624000 mm3 at (30,0,10) minus pocket 12000 at (0,0,17.5): x = 624000*30/612000 = 30.588. The hundredth covers the rounding
